bias.en: Turning bullish · MACD and SAR flipped, back above the 30-day
bias.zh: 转多 · MACD 与 SAR 翻多，重回 30 日均线上方

read.en: Broadcom rose 2.8% on Oct 28 to $351.81, trading between $344.35 and $352.00. It is above the falling 5-day ($333.7), 10-day ($334.8) and 30-day ($349.6) averages and below the falling 100-day ($371.9) and 200-day ($367.8). MACD crossed above its signal on Oct 28, still below zero; Parabolic SAR turned bullish on Oct 28 ($320.23), and RSI is 53.

The close cleared $345.7 (Oct 27 high) and the 30-day ($349.6), now support, as MACD and SAR both turned bullish. Resistance is $354.3–355.1 (Oct 14 high, Oct 2 close), then $359.3–362.5 (Oct 13 high, Oct 5 close) and $367.8 (200-day). Support is $344.4–349.6 (Oct 28 low, 30-day), then $339.2–341.1 and $333.7–334.8 (5 and 10-day). A close above $355 would target $359–368; below $344, $340.

s.en: 30-day average $349.6, reclaimed; Oct 27 high $345.7; Oct 28 low $344.4
